description: Cases the reference Go runner is expected to fail, fall short on, or omit against the Go core commit named by pin, each with the signature the runner prints and the reason. Spec CI compares the runner's results with this file and the corpus (scripts/check-runner-results.mjs): an unexpected failure, shortfall, or omission, a status outside the four run categories, an expected failure or omission that is executed or not run, a changed signature, a missing or extra case, and a pin other than the one the job checked out all fail CI. The pin is the Go commit that adopts this text; the failures and omissions are keyed to it, and a later Go commit reaches CI only by re-keying this file with the job's pin.
